name: Command & Conquer 3: Tiberium Wars
summary: The J2ME version of Command & Conquer 3: Tiberium Wars has little truly in common with its computer and console counterpart save for the universe it is in. Untrue to the franchise, it is a turn-based game split in two phases – base construction and combat. It is set during the Third Tiberium War, and features GDI and Nod units, albeit certain Nod units are reskins of GDI counterparts due to technical limitations. It has only a GDI singleplayer campaign.
